title: Managed Agents: AI agents developed, hosted and monitored | utxo AG
description: utxo AG develops, hosts and monitors your AI agents. You see what is running and decide at defined approval points. Every action is logged.
lede: Your AI agents run in our operations: developed, hosted, monitored and continuously improved by utxo AG. Your team sees the status and decides at the points you define.

scope.title: What we take on for you
scope.text: You do not operate anything yourself. utxo AG develops the agents for your processes, runs them in the agreed environment and takes care of everything that comes up in day-to-day operation.

items.name: Development
items.text: Agents for your specific processes, connected to your systems and tested on real cases from your daily work.

items.name: Hosting
items.text: Operation in the environment that fits your requirements: Germany, EU or on-premise. We decide this per project.

items.name: Monitoring
items.text: We watch every run. If one fails, it is retried or taken over by our team.

items.name: Ongoing development
items.text: We test new versions, model changes and adjustments to changed processes and roll them out during operation.

items.name: Log
items.text: Every action is logged: what an agent did, which sources it used and who approved.

project.title: How a project runs
project.text: Some use cases are in operation within a few weeks, others take months. The process stays the same.

steps.name: First conversation
steps.text: We clarify which processes are suitable, which systems are involved and how you measure the benefit.

steps.name: Concept
steps.text: We describe the agent's steps, its sources and permissions, the approval points and the hosting environment.

steps.name: Development
steps.text: We develop the agent, connect it to your systems and test it on real cases from your daily work.

steps.name: Pilot operation
steps.text: The agent works with a first team under close observation. Feedback goes into the next version.

steps.name: Operation
steps.text: We host, monitor and improve the agent. You see status and log and decide at your approval points.

control.title: What you see and where you decide
control.text: A second example, from the inside sales team of a machine manufacturer: the team lead receives prepared cases, approves them or sends them back with a comment. Every step is in the log, with time and actor.

integration.title: Integration into your systems
integration.text: Agents work where your data and processes already are. Together we define which systems are connected and which permissions an agent receives.

items.name: Connection
items.text: Through interfaces to ERP, CRM, DMS, project storage or email. An agent only receives the permissions it needs for its task.

items.name: Approval points
items.text: You define where a person decides and who that is. Everything else runs through without intervention.

items.name: View for your team
items.text: Status, results and approvals in one view. How your team accesses it, for example through your SSO, is settled in the concept.

items.name: Operation
items.text: utxo AG hosts and monitors the agents. Incidents, retries and new versions are our job and appear in the log.

faq.q: How do Managed Agents differ from agents we operate ourselves?
faq.a: You do not need your own team for operation, monitoring and ongoing development. utxo AG takes on these tasks. You steer through your requirements and approvals and can see at any time what is running.

faq.q: Where do the agents run and where is our data?
faq.a: Hosting follows your requirements: Germany, EU or on-premise. We decide this per project. Processing takes place only on your instructions, without training on your data. We create the DPA individually for your project.
We work model-agnostically and choose the model by task and requirements. We assess the use of local open-source models per project.

faq.q: What happens if a run fails or an agent delivers a wrong result?
faq.a: Every run is monitored. A failed run is retried or goes to our team. Where it matters, a person approves before a result moves on. Every action is in the log and can be traced.

faq.q: How long does it take until an agent is in operation?
faq.a: That depends on the use case. Some are in operation within a few weeks, others take months, for example when several systems are connected. After the first conversation you receive an assessment.

faq.q: Can we change processes and approval points later?
faq.a: Yes. Agents are developed further during operation. If your processes change, or an approval point is to be removed or added, we adjust the agent and roll out the tested new version.
